structureAbout: Each league's shape per season key (matching clubs-meta seasons.list): clubs, games each, how many are promoted as champions, the play-off places (semiFinal = straight into the semi-finals, quarterFinal = the qualifying round, both as [first, last] positions), how many play-off winners go up, and how many are relegated from the bottom. Add the new season's entry before 1 July: the season job will not move the season without it (scripts/bump-season.py, system/new-season-checklist.md).

competitions.entrantsAbout: Who entered, per season key (matching clubs-meta seasons.list). Split by side because they resolve against different files: `members` are codes in clubs-meta.json, `guests` are codes in cup-clubs-meta.json. Entry is NOT a division — a club keeps its real league division while entering the cup (Braintree and Truro are National League South in 2026 but entered). null means not recorded; [] would mean none entered.
